candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on /v1/checkout. Traces show every checkout correlation failing at the order call with 500, and gateway metrics show 502s on /v1/checkout, so the checkout failure originates in the order service's 500 responses.
candidates.uncertainty: Order's own logs and dependency metrics were not admitted, so the internal cause of the 500 (db, redis, payment) is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s caused by order service 500s on POST /v1/orders across all sampled correlations; gateway metrics confirm 502s on /v1/checkout. The bounded cause is order-service HTTP 500 propagating to the gateway. The specific internal dependency failure is not established by admitted evidence.
missing_evidence: Order service logs and error details for the 500 responses on /v1/orders
Order dependency operation metrics (postgresql, payment, inventory) to identify the failing dependency
